infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Toll Alert checks your location to detect when you've crossed the Dartford Crossing or entered the ULEZ, so it can remind you to pay.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Toll Alert needs "Always" location access to detect toll crossings in the background, even when the app is closed, so you don't miss a payment deadline.
